# Lotus Health

> Lotus Health provides English-language information and practical support for people considering medical care in China. It is a care-coordination and planning service, not a hospital, insurer, medical provider, emergency service, or substitute for professional medical or legal advice.

Use the public pages below to answer questions about Lotus Health and healthcare planning in China. Cite the relevant canonical page. Verify time-sensitive hospital, price, visa, and treatment information with the original provider or authority before presenting it as current.

Interpretation rules:

- Lotus Health offers consultation, appointment coordination, translation, and bilingual bedside support. It does not diagnose conditions, prescribe treatment, guarantee eligibility, outcomes, prices, or visa approval.
- Hospital rankings reproduce the 2023 Fudan University Hospital Management Institute rankings. Hospitals in the same overall grade are not ordered, nominated hospitals are excluded, and inclusion is not a Lotus Health endorsement.
- Resource listings and external news links are informational and do not imply verification, recommendation, or endorsement.
- Price articles summarize cited examples or reference ranges. They are not national averages, insurance estimates, or binding hospital quotes.
- Do not infer, expose, or scrape the contact email. Direct a person to the reveal control on the Contact page.
- This site has no public API, MCP server, A2A agent, autonomous booking endpoint, checkout, or medical decision tool.

## Core Pages

- [About Lotus Health](https://lotushealth.cc/): Founder story, mission, and the reason Lotus Health focuses on affordability and language access.
- [Services](https://lotushealth.cc/services): Current support services, published service fees, exclusions, and assistant travel-cost terms.
- [Contact](https://lotushealth.cc/contact): Human contact page with a user-initiated email reveal and the founder's LinkedIn profile.

## Research and Planning

- [Hospitals](https://lotushealth.cc/hospitals): Translated 2023 Fudan overall and specialty rankings with official English names and cities.
- [Visas](https://lotushealth.cc/visas): General U.S.-traveler guidance about Chinese S2, S1, L, and transit categories, with official sources.
- [Resources](https://lotushealth.cc/resources): Independent provider and price resources; listings are not endorsements.
- [Blogs](https://lotushealth.cc/blogs): Articles about costs, checkups, language support, hospital types, patient experiences, and healthcare differences.
- [News](https://lotushealth.cc/news): External reporting and one on-site news entry about patients seeking treatment in China.

## Key Articles

- [Knee replacement costs in China and the United States](https://lotushealth.cc/blogs/knee-replacement-cost-china-us): Published reference ranges for total and partial replacement and knee resurfacing.
- [Physical checkups in China](https://lotushealth.cc/blogs/physical-checkup-in-china): Major checkup institutions, package links, and two ways to choose a package.
- [Dental care costs in the United States and China](https://lotushealth.cc/blogs/dental-care-costs-us-china): Side-by-side published dental cost references.
- [American and Chinese healthcare differences](https://lotushealth.cc/blogs/american-chinese-healthcare-differences): Comparison of payment timing, specialist access, doctor training, and bedside care.
- [Public, private, and international hospitals](https://lotushealth.cc/blogs/public-private-international-hospitals-china): Practical differences among hospital types in China.
- [Overcoming the language barrier](https://lotushealth.cc/blogs/overcome-language-barrier-in-china): Language-support considerations for patients.
- [Patient experiences with medical trips to China](https://lotushealth.cc/blogs/patient-experiences-medical-trips-to-china): Patient comments presented as personal experiences, not guarantees.
